_schema: Each entry: {id, status, blocker, impact, revisit (milestone-when-revisit), evidence (note/ADR path)}; optional workaround/mitigation, milestone (discovered). Deferrals are honesty, not silence (GOAL.md). Runtime-visible on the M8 dashboard deferral registry.

deferred.revisit: closed by the canonical source's software exception accumulator; retain this row as resolved audit history
deferred.blocker: Resolved: WebAssembly still has no floating-point exception status register, but BLI_expr_pylike_eval no longer depends on it under Emscripten. The canonical source accumulates explicit divide-by-zero and invalid-operation status through constant folding and runtime evaluation.
deferred.impact: The old nine wasm-only expr_pylike failures no longer exist. Fresh Linux native and wasm runs pass the same 144 focused expr_pylike cases and the same complete 1,667-test BLI identity with zero failures; overflow remains outside the evaluator's error contract on both platforms.
deferred.workaround: The initial patch-0004 compile-only macro fallback is historical and insufficient by itself. Keep the software accumulator and its signaling-NaN, composite-operation, fmod-domain, pole, and overflow controls in the canonical source.

deferred.revisit: m2b — relaxed wasm tolerance or a libm review
deferred.blocker: Blender's vector/matrix math is float32; the wasm libm (acosf/sqrtf/etc.) rounds differently from native arm64, so last-ULP numeric divergences appear versus the native oracle.
deferred.impact: 3 m2b CORE suites diverge (green on native, fail on wasm): script_pyapi_mathutils test_orthogonal (bl_pyapi_mathutils.py:666, 1.570796251296997 != 1.5707963267948966, Δ7.5e-08, places=7); script_pyapi_bmesh (failures=2: 651.346363723278 != 651.346448 Δ8.4e-05 + one set-membership diff); bl_constraints (Object-Solver matrix 0.20000046 != 0.19999939 Δ1.07e-06 at [1][3]).
deferred.workaround: Relax the wasm tier-b tolerance for these numeric asserts, or review the specific libm calls; a genuine cross-platform-precision datum, not a correctness bug.

deferred.revisit: structural fix is probe-gated (wasm64 -sMEMORY64 vs wasm32 pointer interning), likely post-M4 / pre-launch; LAUNCH.md drag-drop depends on it landing before M8
deferred.blocker: Reading 64-bit .blend files on wasm32 truncates 8-byte block addresses into 4 bytes assuming 8-byte alignment (>>3 at BLO_core_bhead.hh:124 / dna_genfile.cc:929). Real writers emit sub-8-aligned adjacent DATA blocks whose distinct addresses then collide → duplicate map insert (loud abort) or mis-resolved pointer fields (silent corruption). Data-dependent: most files pass, some break.
deferred.impact: Affected m2b suites reclassify to blocked-by-ADR-004 (e.g. bl_node_structure_type_inference: 'Blendfile corruption: Invalid, or multiple bhead with same old address value' -> Aborted). Launch drag-drop of arbitrary user .blend cannot ship on wasm32 as-is.
deferred.mitigation: ADR-004 Decision 1: a loud collision detector (patch 0017, wasm32-only #ifdef) at BHead-index build time refuses a colliding read with an explicit error naming the ADR — converts silent corruption into a deterministic user-visible failure, zero behavior change for the non-colliding majority. Detector active; this is the safety net, not the fix.

deferred.revisit: M3 T9 texture integration — emulate, or confirm no shipping shader needs snorm16
deferred.blocker: WebGPU/Dawn exposes 16-bit UNORM formats (Unorm16TextureFormats feature) but has NO 16-bit SNORM support at this pin: RGBA16Snorm/R16Snorm/RG16Snorm enumerators exist in webgpu_cpp.h yet no FeatureName enables them, so CreateTexture fails validation. Metal supports MTLPixelFormatRGBA16Snorm — this is a Dawn/WebGPU-surface gap, not hardware.
deferred.impact: 4 of 63 Blender texture formats unsupported: SNORM_16, SNORM_16_16, SNORM_16_16_16, SNORM_16_16_16_16. The other 59 create live and 50/50 color formats round-trip byte-exact on Dawn/Metal.
deferred.workaround: Emulate: (1) store as RGBA16Uint/Unorm + shader remap snorm=value/32767.0 (exact over [-1,1]); or (2) promote to RGBA16Float (lossy at ULP). Blender uses snorm16 rarely (mostly normal/vector textures).

deferred.revisit: M5/M6 — wgpu_batch point-draw expansion + BSL preprocessor prologue (UI/overlay dots, keyframes, particles, edit-mode verts)
deferred.blocker: WebGPU points are always 1px; WGSL has no gl_PointSize builtin and no gl_PointCoord. Every GPU_PRIM_POINTS shader that writes gl_PointSize must be rewritten to draw an instanced quad per point.
deferred.impact: ~23 shaders affected: 8 in gpu/shaders/ (2D/3D point uniform/varying-size AA, keyframe_shape) + ~15 in draw/engines/overlay/shaders/ (loose verts, particles, edit-mode dots).
deferred.workaround: Mechanically-specified R1-R4 instanced-quad rewrite; the prototype compiles through the real T7 chain (shaderc->Tint->WGSL) and renders pixel-accurate 1/5/9px point coverage on live Dawn/Metal. Recommended placement is codegen-level (wgpu_batch draw expansion + preprocessor prologue), mirroring Blender's wide-line solution — zero upstream shader edits.

deferred.revisit: M4+ GHOST-web — capability currently off
deferred.blocker: Browser IME is asynchronous (compositionstart/update/end events); wiring dead-keys / composition needs mapping to GHOST_kEventImeComposition* + GHOST_TEventImeData.
deferred.impact: IME / dead-key composition input path not implemented in the custom GHOST-web backend; the Infrom-IME capability is off. Direct key input is unaffected.
deferred.workaround: Add the compositionstart/update/end -> GHOST_kEventImeComposition* bridge when a locale/IME-dependent workflow is in scope.

deferred.revisit: pending the hunt's outcome — one instrumented build + a ~150-run background hunt to separate race vs uninitialized-read (fix is copy-on-eval/tree-lock isolation if race, zero-init the reused socket field if uninit)
deferred.blocker: Non-deterministic (~1.4%, ~1 in 70): after the node-group ungroup operator on the threaded wasm profile (-sPROXY_TO_PTHREAD + TBB), a ShaderNodeValue proxy node's output 'Value' socket intermittently resolves to NodeSocketUndefined instead of NodeSocketFloat. Deterministic + correct on the native oracle and on the direct-add control (both wasm and native). Leading hypotheses: a data race (GN eval on TBB workers concurrent with the next operator's tree mutation) or an uninitialized read of a freed-then-reused bNodeSocket field.
deferred.impact: bl_node_copy_operators test_ungroup_proxy_nodes flakes (bl_node_copy_operators.py:426, 'NodeSocketUndefined' != 'NodeSocketFloat', x4 together). A node-system/threading heisenbug, not a one-line port-class fix — STOP disposition per the fix gate.
deferred.resolution: CONFIRMED-FIXED-BY-f7ec391 (shared OIIO ustring TableRep root cause; 0/150 instrumented hunt on fixed build; commit 184035c)

deferred.revisit: M7 / multi-tab — per-context copybuffer path
deferred.blocker: Node clipboard copy writes to a SHARED copybuffer temp path (node_copybuffer_filepath_get, clipboard.cc:48). Concurrent/multi-context processes collide on that path so write_as_copypaste_buffer returns false and node_clipboard_copy_exec hits BLI_assert (clipboard.cc:241, 'marked unreachable').
deferred.impact: Harmless for the sequential m2b gate; a real hazard for any concurrent/multi-context wasm build (browser multi-tab), where two contexts sharing the temp path abort on clipboard copy.
deferred.workaround: Give each context (tab/window) its own copybuffer path.

deferred.revisit: M2.6 — re-enable per actual tier-b suite need (harvest the Hacl hashlib archives; re-add sqlite3/decimal/etc. with proper deps)
deferred.blocker: The browser CPython 3.13.13 target links without several optional C-extension modules whose only unmet deps are external/companion libs absent from the mono-wasm link: hashlib backends (_md5/_sha1/_sha2/_sha3/_blake2 — CPython's per-algorithm Hacl archives), _multiprocessing (no fork/exec in a single wasm module), and (disabled for a self-contained libpython) _sqlite3/_bz2/_decimal/pyexpat/_elementtree.; _ctypes (libffi) absent — now the sole blocker for script_load_addons/modules (numpy no longer blocks, 2026-08-05)
deferred.impact: import hashlib during bpy startup logs ~28 'unsupported hash type' tracebacks then degrades gracefully (module-level try/except); _multiprocessing -> one ModuleNotFoundError during bpy app setup. Both non-fatal — import bpy + operators boot green. Blocks the AMBER m2b suites script_disk_file_hash_service_test (needs sqlite3) and any tier-b suite that actually computes a hash.
deferred.workaround: decimal falls back to pure-python _pydecimal; re-harvest the Hacl SHA archives + re-enable modules with real deps at M2.6 when a suite needs them; multiprocessing is not usable in a single wasm module regardless.

deferred.revisit: M7
post-launch - WGSL has no storage-texture atomic path; revisit if WGSL/Dawn gains image atomics or an SSBO-atomic emulation of the affected passes is scoped
deferred.blocker: WGSL has no storage-texture atomics: imageAtomic* maps to SPIR-V OpImageTexelPointer, which Tint's SPIR-V reader rejects ('tint ReadIR: unhandled SPIR-V OpImageTexelPointer'). No Dawn FeatureName enables image atomics at this pin.
deferred.impact: 8 static shaders using imageAtomic fail to compile (part of static_shaders 951/973) and the shader_texture_atomic test crashes (signal 11 - compile fails -> null module -> bind/dispatch segfault, honest).
deferred.workaround: Where the algorithm allows, re-express the image atomic as a storage-buffer (SSBO) atomic over an equivalent linear layout; not a general drop-in, so deferred until a shipping shader needs it.

deferred.revisit: post-launch - restructure the affected passes to move read_write storage writes into a compute prepass (vertex stage reads read-only storage only)
deferred.blocker: WebGPU forbids var<storage, read_write> in the vertex pipeline stage; Tint rejects it: 'var storage/read_write cannot be used by vertex pipeline stage'.
deferred.impact: 4 static shaders fail to compile (draw_curves_test, draw_debug_draw_display, eevee_shadow_tag_update, gpu_graphic_specialization_test; part of static_shaders 951/973) and the specialization_constants_graphic test crashes (signal 11).
deferred.workaround: Split the pass: perform the read_write storage writes in a separate compute pass, leaving the vertex stage with read-only storage.
deferred.evidence: notes/gpu-gate-census.md (i) deferral candidates + FAIL #1 (vertex-stage read_write SSBO 4) / CRASH #10 (specialization_constants_graphic)

deferred.revisit: when a buffer->depth upload workflow is in scope - emulate via a fullscreen depth-write render pass instead of a buffer copy
deferred.blocker: WebGPU forbids writing the depth aspect of a texture via a buffer->texture copy (buffer->depth-aspect copies are invalid). The clear + read-back paths work.
deferred.impact: 2 texture_roundtrip tests fail (GPU_DEPTH32F_STENCIL8, GPU_DEPTH_COMPONENT32F; 'max_used_bias 0.875 > 0'). Depth textures can be cleared and read back; only the buffer-copy upload path is unsupported.
deferred.workaround: Write depth via a render pass (fragment depth output) rather than a buffer->texture copy.
deferred.evidence: notes/gpu-gate-census.md (i) deferral candidates + FAIL #6/#7 (texture_roundtrip depth-aspect upload)

deferred.revisit: later fix - unpack I10 in the vertex shader from a Uint source, or CPU pre-expand to a supported signed format, when packed-normal attributes reach the shipping viewport
deferred.blocker: WebGPU has no signed snorm10-10-10-2 vertex format; wgpu_pipeline.cc:86 maps GPU_COMP_I10 (signed 2_10_10_10_REV, used for packed mesh normals) to VF::Unorm10_10_10_2, so the unsigned read drops the sign.
deferred.impact: vertex_buffer_fetch_mode GPU_COMP_I10 INT_TO_FLOAT_UNIT fails: got (160,256,255,0), want (321,-511,511,0). Affects packed mesh-normal vertex attributes.
deferred.workaround: Unpack signed 2_10_10_10 in the vertex shader from a Uint10_10_10_2/Uint32 source, or pre-expand on CPU to Snorm16x4.
deferred.evidence: notes/gpu-gate-census.md (i) deferral candidates + FAIL #8 (vertex_buffer_fetch_mode GPU_COMP_I10); wgpu_pipeline.cc:86
deferred.closed: 2026-08-09 by patch 0119 (r37, commit d0f48c7): normalized GPU_COMP_I10 maps to VF::Snorm8x4 with packed-data transcode at upload (the revisit note's "CPU pre-expand to a supported signed format" option). Native census test vertex_buffer_fetch_mode I10 INT_TO_FLOAT_UNIT now PASSES (bar 148/8/2 -> 149/7/2); web gbuffer -Y normals verified correct via the 0117 readback. Residual: the harness EXPECT_NONPASS map still lists the test (human-locked file, flagged in the ledger).

deferred.revisit: extensions-online / networked features work (M7-adjacent): implement a real browser fetch transport backing the js + pyodide.ffi namespace (option B, notes/python-emcc605-probe.md THE NEXT WALL), or a native urllib3 emscripten transport
deferred.blocker: urllib3 2.4.0 hard-codes a Pyodide runtime on sys.platform=='emscripten' (urllib3/__init__.py:208-211 unconditionally runs inject_into_urllib3(); contrib/emscripten/fetch.py:45-46 imports js + pyodide.ffi, modules only the Pyodide RUNTIME provides). Our non-Pyodide browser CPython has no JavaScript bridge, so no Python-level HTTP transport exists.
deferred.impact: Python-level HTTP is non-functional on the wasm build: bl_pkg online repo sync / extension download (_bpy_internal/http/downloader.py) and any requests/urllib3 use raise on use (AttributeError/NotImplementedError naming this id). Import and bl_pkg register are CLEAN via raise-on-use import-shims (scripts/deps/python-shims/js.py + pyodide/, installed by scripts/deps/wheels.sh), so boot and the M4 first-pixels golden are unaffected. Offline/bundled extensions unaffected.
deferred.workaround: import-shims satisfy urllib3's import-time environment probes (hasattr sniffs -> all report unavailable, no worker spawned, streaming fetcher None, has_jspi False via its ImportError path); urllib3's own no-streaming fallback warning surfaces through a log-only js.console; first actual bridge touch (js.XMLHttpRequest) raises naming this deferral
deferred.evidence: notes/python-emcc605-probe.md (THE NEXT WALL + shim verification WASM_SHIM_IMPORT_OK)

deferred.progress: DIAGNOSTIC readback path DONE (M4 r31, patch 0117): WGPUTexture::diag_kick_readback submits CopyTextureToBuffer + MapAsync and RETURNS; the completion is delivered on the WM worker's own event loop between main-loop ticks via CallbackMode::AllowSpontaneous (the DECISIVE lever: AllowProcessEvents + instance.ProcessEvents does NOT deliver in the imported-device windowed profile, AllowSpontaneous DOES). Proven live: reads the viewport-colour texture back non-uniform after the grid renders, and the gbuffer depth/material/normal/objectid mid-frame. Bytes land in /tmp/bw_readback_<n>.bin (header + 256-pad stripped), pulled via FS.readFile. Inert unless env BW_DIAG set. M6 SUITE MEASUREMENT NOW COVERED (M6 r35, patch 0125): a BW_DIAG-gated hook at the top of WGPUTexture::read (the seam BOTH GPU_texture_read and GPU_framebuffer_read_color -> WGPUFrameBuffer::read funnel through) kicks the r31 tick-pumped readback so the F12 render's true device bytes surface in the diag file for the r35 comparator to decode + oiiotool-score against the M6 goldens. PROVEN on the workbench factory cube (real shaded RGBA16Float pixels, 0 GPU errors, Standard view transform = linear->sRGB). M5 L-A PRODUCTION PRIMITIVE DONE (r53, patch 0133): both WGPUTexture::read and webgpu::Buffer::read now use the heap-owned AllowSpontaneous kick/latch/settle registry on wasm, including buffer-source support, bounded in-flight/settled queues, span-aware keys, kind-aware retirement, orphan-safe deduplication, and immutable exact ticket payloads. The old wasm WaitAny lambda with a caller-stack capture is compiled out, closing the back-to-back snapshot table-OOB lifetime hazard; native keeps the verbatim blocking path. Browser proof returns exact [51,153,229,255] bytes one tick late, survives 24 render.opengl+screenshot operations, preserves the 2/2 diagnostic bridge, and holds the 149/7/2 plus 956/973 census. M5 L-B + L-C/C1 SOURCE CONTRACT DONE (2026-08-24, d58164f): the public GPUReadback owned-result API, texture/storage async entry points, WebGPU exact-ticket overrides, select-instance ownership transfer, and View3D object-pick modal continuation are bound across 20 files. The actual gpu_readback.cc and gpu_select_next.cc pass byte-identical native/wasm32 lifetime, all-mode exact-replay, map-ownership, cancellation, and failure-retirement contracts; six source mutations fail closed. VIEWPORT COLOUR CALLER DONE (2026-08-24, c9ac6eb, patch 0249): ViewportColorSampleSession owns an exact async texture ticket, confirmation resumes through a bounded modal timer, pending cannot enter the synchronous window fallback, and failure/timeout cancels before copied-texture release. Five native/wasm32 contracts and 12 cases are byte-identical; the seven-file source receipt and eight mutation controls pass. SCREENSHOT OPERATOR DONE (2026-08-24, patch 0250): the stock screen screenshot captures before opening its file selector, retains one exact WM offscreen ticket across that selector, and resumes direct or early-confirmed execution through a bounded modal timer; terminal failure, timeout, and cancel retire the GPU request before its offscreen. Six native/wasm32 contracts and 12 cases are byte-identical. WINDOW COLOUR FALLBACK DONE (2026-08-24, patch 0252): EyedropperWindowColorSampleSession owns one full-window WM asynchronous snapshot shared by the main colour eyedropper, colour-band gradient/point sampling, and grease-pencil material sampling. All three modal consumers retain their exact event/action state behind bounded timers; failure, timeout, cancel, and window replacement retire the request before its pixels. Six native/wasm32 contracts and 13 cases are byte-identical, and the six-file source verifier rejects 11 mutations. PAINTING CLONE-CURSOR DONE (2026-08-24, 91f2974, patch 0261): texture paint owns the latest progressive-depth request and defers the exact finish event behind bounded settlement; eight native/wasm32 contracts and 13 cases are byte-identical. NDOF DEPTH-PICK DONE (2026-08-24, patch 0263): the bounds-first fallback owns its exact rectangle request and queues exact NDOF motion payloads FIFO behind a bounded, producing-view-guarded continuation; eight native/wasm32 contracts and 20 cases are byte-identical. This is device-free source evidence only and carries no adapter, browser, profile, split product, or live M5 receipt. See notes/gpu-r35-render-result-bridge.md + notes/m6-gpu-suite-real-scores.md + notes/gpu-r53-readback-primitive.md + notes/m5-async-readback-contract-reconcile-20260824.md + notes/m5-viewport-color-readback-20260824.md + notes/m5-screenshot-async-readback-20260824.md + notes/m5-window-color-readback-20260824.md + notes/m5-painting-depth-continuation-20260824.md + notes/m5-ndof-depth-continuation-20260824.md. INTERACTIVE ANNOTATION DEPTH-CACHE CALLER DONE (2026-08-25, patch 0266): GPENCIL_OT_annotate draw, polyline-update, and depth-aware eraser events use one owned cache generation, with exact initial-event resumption and chained FIFO replay across invalidation; eight native/wasm32 contracts and 18 cases are byte-identical. RECORDED-STROKE ANNOTATION DEPTH-CACHE CALLER DONE (2026-08-25, a9074d2, patch 0267): exec snapshots the exact mouse, pressure, time, and is_start fields, then resumes the stock point and stroke-boundary order across owned cache generations; 13 native/wasm32 contracts and 31 cases are byte-identical, and 17 focused plus 40 aggregate mutations fail closed. This remains device-free source evidence and carries no adapter, browser, profile, split product, or live M5 receipt.

deferred.revisit: M5 gizmo interaction parity: convert the legacy sample-query selection caller to an encode/resolve/poll continuation, or route browser gizmo picking through the asynchronous Select-Next path
deferred.blocker: WebGPU occlusion results require resolving a query set and asynchronously mapping a result buffer.
